_comment: Read fresh on every run. Edit freely, no launchd reload needed.
_books: name = ZIM file prefix before _YYYY-MM.zim; dir = folder under the mirror. Browse https://download.kiwix.org/zim/ for others. mdwiki_en_all_maxi is WikiProjectMed's medical wiki (the content of the WikiMed app). wikipedia_en_all_nopic (approx. 49 GiB, text only) replaced wikipedia_en_all_maxi (approx. 119 GiB, with images) on 2026-10-27 to save space on the shared SSD.
_check_every_hours: StartOnMount fires on every mount of any volume, so the mirror is checked at most this often. An unfinished download ignores the limit and resumes at once.
